# Shailesh Chaudhari — Portfolio

> Software Engineer (~2.5 years), TypeScript/Node, backend-strongest, applied AI. Current role: Node.js backend of ContextQA's core QA-automation platform (test-execution engine, live browser-session streaming, integrations engine, session control plane on GKE).

Shailesh Chaudhari is a Software Engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (originally from Patan, Gujarat). BE in Information Technology from Government Engineering College, Bhavnagar (2024, CGPA 7.99). Institute Rank 1 on GeeksforGeeks with 604+ problems solved.

Professional timeline:
- Jan 2024 – Aug 2024: Software Developer Intern at EsparkBiz Technologies (REST APIs and React/Next.js interfaces with authentication and RBAC; Stripe and Supabase auth integrations).
- Aug 2024 – Jul 2025: Software Engineer at EsparkBiz Technologies (3 client projects end-to-end — full-stack UI, backend APIs, client communication and requirements).
- Jul 2025 – present: Software Engineer at ContextQA. First 2-3 months: shipped 2 Chrome extensions (Vibe Testing for AI-assisted web testing, AxeTos for WCAG accessibility). Since then: the Node.js backend of the core QA-automation platform — a test-execution engine orchestrating concurrent browser and mobile runs (Playwright, WebdriverIO/Appium, LambdaTest), live browser-session streaming over WebSockets (noVNC proxied through a Node control plane), a debug engine with breakpoints and resume-from-checkpoint; primary author of the integrations engine (GitHub App, GitLab and Linear OAuth, Slack bot, webhook ingestion; multi-tenant via OAuth state in Redis and tenant resolution by installation id); the session control plane on GKE (pre-warmed pod pool over Redis, idempotent stop, request trace ids, stable error codes and a diagnostics bundle for on-prem customers). Also contributes to the platform's Java (Spring Boot) and Python services.

## Side projects (shipped)

Live:

- [KhataGO](https://khatago.vercel.app/): WhatsApp-first bookkeeping for Indian MSMEs. WhatsApp Business webhook with DB-enforced idempotency (unique message id + an atomic PENDING→PROCESSING claim, no cache in the path); a containerized polling worker over a Postgres-backed queue with an atomic claim, exponential backoff with jitter, and a dead-letter queue with audited replay; Gemini function-calling (10 tools) for text and receipt OCR → structured transactions + receivables; Tally XML export. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Gemini AI SDK, WhatsApp Cloud API, Docker, i18n (en/hi/gu).
- [EduScale](https://eduscale.vercel.app/): Real-time engineering learning platform with 1v1 coding battles. Backend uses @socket.io/redis-adapter (horizontal Socket.io scaling), redlock (distributed locks on the battle start / submit-answer / complete paths), opossum (circuit breaker around the Judge0 code-execution call), prom-client (Prometheus /metrics: request duration, active connections, memory), and a Bull queue with a dead-letter queue for email. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase Auth.
- [DevTrack](https://daily-dev-track.vercel.app): Developer productivity dashboard. Supabase Realtime postgres_changes subscription on daily_logs for live activity feed + sub-second multi-tab sync. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase Realtime, Recharts.

Open source:

- [BALLAST](https://github.com/Shailesh93602/ballast): Deterministic simulation of a multi-tenant session control plane — per-tenant concurrency caps, quota windows, leases over an unreliable substrate. Every run is a pure function of one integer seed (1,000 seeds replay byte-identically). Verified four ways: 8 invariants, a reference oracle, mutation testing (158 of 165 mutants killed, 197 tests), a self-verifying shrinker. 9 real findings in docs/LEDGER.md, 4 of them in the checker. Zero runtime dependencies.
- [CodeSenseiSearch](https://github.com/Shailesh93602/CodeSenseiSearch): AI-powered semantic code search, in progress. NestJS backend scaffolding with pgvector, AST-aware function/class-level chunking, Gemini embeddings. The ingestion → embedding → retrieval pipeline is scaffolded, not yet wired end to end.

ContextQA Chrome extensions (shipped in first 2-3 months at ContextQA, 2025):

- Vibe Testing: Chrome extension for AI-assisted web testing with real-time log streaming. Stack: Chrome Extension, Python AI Agent, Node.js, Socket.io.
- AxeTos: Chrome extension for WCAG A/AA/AAA accessibility testing with fix suggestions. Stack: Chrome Extension, Node.js, axe-core, AWS S3.
